lemmas.name: isSub_append
lemmas.statement: ∀ (F Z : List Int), isSubsequence F (F ++ Z) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro F Z
  induction F with
  | nil => simp [isSubsequence]
  | cons a t ih => simp [isSubsequence, ih]

lemmas.name: countVal_eq
lemmas.statement: ∀ (v : Int) (l : List Int), countVal v l = l.count v
lemmas.proof:
by intro v l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [countVal]
  | cons a t ih => simp only [countVal, ih, List.count_cons]; split_ifs <;> simp_all

lemmas.name: move56
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : moveZeroes_precond xs), moveZeroes_postcond xs (xs.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ 0)) ++ xs.filter (fun x => decide (x = 0))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h
  unfold moveZeroes_postcond
  have hperm : (xs.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ 0)) ++ xs.filter (fun x => decide (x = 0))).Perm xs := by
    have := List.filter_append_perm (fun x : Int => decide (x ≠ 0)) xs
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨isSub_append _ _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    rw [List.dropWhile_append] at hx
    split_ifs at hx with hemp
    · have := List.dropWhile_subset _ hx
      simpa using (List.mem_filter.mp this).2
    · exfalso; apply hemp
      have : List.dropWhile (fun x => decide (x ≠ 0)) (xs.filter (fun x => decide (x ≠ 0))) = [] :=
        List.dropWhile_eq_nil_iff.mpr (fun y hy => (List.mem_filter.mp hy).2)
      simp [this]
  · rw [countVal_eq, countVal_eq]; exact (hperm.count_eq 0).symm
  · exact hperm.length_eq.symm
